spec.rationale: It pairs a lion head and tufted tail with a tiger torso, limbs and striped coat to stand and hunt as a quadruped carnivore, walking on land as primary while swimming in water only opportunistically. It lives as a terrestrial hunter in wetlands with seasonal water dependence and a temperate-to-tropical thermal range excluding tundra extremes, without inheriting captive liger fertility.
spec.name: Maned Striped Panther

warnings.message: A fusion design inspired by a real hybrid must not claim the real hybrid's fertility unless its parents and cross direction match that hybrid exactly.
warnings.detail: documented real hybrid(s): liger (father: lion (Panthera leo) × mother: tiger (Panthera tigris); fertility fertile=partial; Male lion x female tiger; exists only in captivity per source; male ligers sterile, female ligers fertile); tigon (father: tiger (Panthera tigris) × mother: lion (Panthera leo); fertility fertile=partial; Male tiger x female lion; found only in captivity per source; male tigons sterile, females fertile). This fusion does not inherit their fertility.

warnings.message: A fusion combining a tundra parent and a tropical parent must state its thermal range; it may not be assumed to live in both extremes without a note.
A fusion with a wetland parent must not be recorded as purely terrestrial or purely aquatic without a note on its water dependence.
A fusion that walks and swims must state whether it walks on land and swims in water, or whether one medium is primary.
A fusion recorded in a wetland must state whether it is aquatic, semi-aquatic or terrestrial in that wetland.

spec.prompt:
Reference image 1 shows a lion. Use it only for the head and tail.
Reference image 2 shows a tiger. Use it only for the torso, limbs and skin covering.
Create one new creature with a single, committed quadruped body plan.
Place the lion's head and tail on the tiger's frame so every join heals naturally: no visible seams, no floating parts, no duplicated limbs.
Stay close to the documented liger, a real hybrid of these parents.
Show the full body in a calm three-quarter view on a plain, softly lit background, in the style of a natural history field-guide plate. Photographic realism, accurate anatomy, no text, no labels, no people.
